CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.

2. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.
   C. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.

3. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

4. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

5. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.

7. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   B. Practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   D. Damage equipment used for String Musical Instruments and Drawing.

8. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   C. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.
   D. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

10. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

11. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

12. Best practice when working on Weaving: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Weaving.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Weaving.
   C. Practise Weaving with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Weaving.

13. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.

15. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts 3.1 Analysis of Cre and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works 15 Total Number of Lessons 180 NOTE: The suggest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts works and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
